prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side.

#1: a deep blue-black complexion, early 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, tight cornrows in natural black — full body UV neon lightning web bodypaint covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Bold formations — BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD lightning bolt formations branching across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID NEON YELLOW spark burst formations filling every gap, STARK WHITE electric arc highlights, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot with zero white light reaching her specifically, every formation glowing at maximum intensity. Pose: back to the camera, shoulder blades emphasized, face turned in profile — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: Footwear: thigh-high platform stiletto boots entirely in the exact same colours as her own body art — blazing electric emerald, vivid neon yellow and stark white — NOT black, NOT dark, NOT plain — the footwear must be a bright, saturated, glossy colour taken straight from her own body art, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
#1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her forearm is wide, painted in the same colours as her body art with UV reactive tips.
#1: Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#1: Face: her face and ears are NOT painted — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: heavily smudged black eyeshadow blazing from the lash line up to the temples, thick smeared black liner all around the eyes, clumped black lashes top and bottom, fully opaque saturated jet-black lips, deeply shadowed black contour under the cheekbones.

#2: a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, mid 40s, a legendary Eastern beauty said to topple nations, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, wolf cut honey blonde hair — full body carved cinnabar lacquer fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid lacquered curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted lacquer sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep carved cinnabar-red lacquer with scrolling cloud relief across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID black lacquer grooves between the sections, with thin brass inlay lines running along the grain of every section, deep-gloss lacquered, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: S-curve stance, one knee bent, hip tilted out, one hand resting on her thigh — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#2: Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of the same lacquer, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
#2: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same lacquer with a high polish.
#2: Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#2: Face: her face and ears are NOT lacquer — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: thick saturated near-black burgundy lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, deep plum-brown smoky eyes, dramatic lashes.

Environment: the Court of the Lions at the Alhambra with a pale marble floor, slender arcade columns, standard-height arched doorways and a low fountain, empty of visitors, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as any of them.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere, every element standing in true relief, nothing flat. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
